The '''1986–87 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], six points ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Clydebank F.C. (1965)|Clydebank]] and [[Hamilton Academical F.C.|Hamilton Academical]] were relegated.
